summary: Over 48 hours during monsoon-season afternoon thunderstorms, Saguache SAR responded to two calls for service, rescuing three people suffering hypothermia on area trails.
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page. Date approximate: 'in the last 48 hours' before 2022-08-26 post; listed as 2022-08-25. Two calls combined in one row; cannot be split from post text.
